Something happened in a market today

September 15, 2026 at 10:31 PM UTC

A company nobody had heard of a year ago is holding early talks with investors about a funding round that would value it at more than a trillion dollars, according to a person familiar with the talks who asked not to be identified because the discussions are private.

Any decision to go ahead will hinge on exactly when the company decides to go public, the person said, and the talks were initiated by the investors rather than by the company. A spokesman declined to comment on any of it, which is the part of this story that is not in doubt.
